# Norwegian University of Science and Technology - NTNU

> NTNU is Norway's premier science and technology university in Trondheim with 40,000 students, offering international master's programs, PhD education, cutting-edge research, and innovation partnerships across multiple campuses.

NTNU serves as a major research institution with strategic focus areas in energy, health, and security, while actively supporting international students and researchers through comprehensive academic and practical resources across campuses in Trondheim, Gjøvik, and Ålesund.
